question: A reduction of 25% in the price of an item enables a purchaser to obtain 5 items more for ₹240. The original price of the item is:
solution:
Calculation:

Let the cost of the item initially be "a".

∴ New cost per item = (1 - 0.25) × a = 0.75a

Total items bought initially = 240over a

Total items bought under reduced price = 240over 0.75a

According to the question-

⇒ 240over 0.75a - 240over a = 5

⇒ 240over a × (1over 0.75 - 1) = 5

⇒ a = 240 × (1)/(5) × (0.25)/(0.75) = Rs 16

The original price of the item was Rs 16.
